role_agent_name: Fleet planning and ground operations lead (OPS)
abstract: Maintains customer hangar allocation commitments, customer priority reservations, and labor agreement status
system_message:
You are the Fleet planning and ground operations lead (OPS). Your responsibilities include maintaining customer hangar allocation commitments, customer priority reservations, and labor agreement status, as well as tracking ferry flight fuel provisioning requirements across maintenance partner facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ferry flight fuel provisioning（FUEL）
information_points.content:
OPS-FUEL-XCP：According to the flight dispatch operations plan for Nordic Airframe Services Dresden, the post-maintenance acceptance test flight requirements specify an emergency tankering fuel buffer of 1500 kg in dedicated reserve aviation fuel.
OPS-FUEL-UXA：According to the flight dispatch operations plan for Aerospace Maintenance Technics Shannon, the emergency tankering fuel buffer for post-maintenance acceptance test flights is established at 1800 kg of minimum dedicated reserve aviation fuel.
OPS-FUEL-XIO：According to the flight dispatch operations plan for Iberia Precision Aerostructures Seville, the minimum dedicated reserve aviation fuel load provides an emergency tankering fuel buffer of 1200 kg for post-maintenance acceptance test flights.

information_points.title: Maintains customer hangar allocation commitments, customer priority reservations, and labor agreement status（FLEET）
information_points.content:
OPS-FLEET-AH5：For Nordic Airframe Services Dresden, a workforce collective bargaining stability pact is ratified with the licensed technician and avionics mechanic union, establishing guaranteed uninterrupted shifts via a signed multi-year agreement. Furthermore, the facility carries 2500 h of mandatory reserved customer support hours locked each year for third-party priority contractual reservations addressing ad-hoc AOG and unscheduled defect mitigation.
OPS-FLEET-757：For Iberia Precision Aerostructures Seville, a workforce collective bargaining stability pact is not ratified with the licensed technician and avionics mechanic union. The hangar slot allocation registry also indicates 3000 h of mandatory reserved customer support hours committed annually for third-party priority reservations handling ad-hoc AOG and unscheduled defect mitigation.
OPS-FLEET-G04：For Aerospace Maintenance Technics Shannon, the labor relations registry confirms that a workforce collective bargaining stability pact is ratified with the licensed technician and avionics mechanic union, guaranteeing uninterrupted shifts under a signed multi-year agreement. Additionally, hangar slot allocations specify 2500 h of mandatory reserved customer support hours locked annually for third-party priority reservations covering ad-hoc AOG and unscheduled defect mitigation.
